intro_html: Crispy potatoes and spicy pork chorizo with charred bell pepper and a bright tomatillo-cilantro-lime finish. Each bowl comes in at 656 calories with 25 grams of protein for about $4.15 (at everyday cost). Chorizo brings so much seasoning on its own that half the spice cabinet gets the day off.
cost_closing_html: About $4.15 a bowl (at everyday cost) for chorizo con papas that a breakfast-burrito spot would happily charge $10 to $12 to wrap in a tortilla. The potatoes are doing the heavy lifting in this one.
shop_smart: Potatoes are the ultimate budget filler: 7 pounds for $3.08 stretches 4.5 pounds of chorizo across 14 full bowls.
Chorizo tubes are the cheap cut of the pork case at about $1.50 per 9 ounce tube, and the seasoning is already inside the meat. You are buying spice and fat in one package.
Tomatillos, cilantro, and lime make a quick fresh salsa for about $3. A jarred salsa verde of the same volume runs $6 or more.
make_it: Weigh your empty mixing pot and write the number down for portioning later.
Dice the potatoes into half-inch cubes, toss with olive oil, salt, chili powder, and garlic powder, and roast at 425 F for 30 to 35 minutes until crispy, flipping once.

While the potatoes roast, brown the chorizo in your big pot over medium heat, breaking it up, 8 to 10 minutes until fully cooked and starting to crisp. Pork chorizo is done when it reads 160 F or higher and no pink remains.
Add the diced red bell pepper to the chorizo and cook 4 to 5 minutes until softened in the rendered fat.
Make the quick salsa: finely chop the tomatillos and stir with the cilantro, lime juice, and a pinch of salt and black pepper. For a smoother salsa, pulse it in a blender.
Fold the roasted potatoes into the chorizo and peppers so everything gets coated.
Portion into 14 containers and spoon the tomatillo salsa over each, or pack it on the side to keep it bright.
portion_html: Weigh the finished pot of chorizo, peppers, and potatoes, subtract the empty pot weight you wrote down, and divide by 14. Each bowl comes out to about 656 calories with 25 grams of protein.

steps: Roast seasoned diced potatoes at 425 F until crispy.
Brown the chorizo fully, then soften the diced red bell pepper in the drippings.
Chop tomatillos and mix with cilantro and lime juice for a quick salsa.
Fold the crispy potatoes into the chorizo and peppers.
Portion into 14 containers and top with the tomatillo salsa.
